claim.value: Missing records may affect the record paths available for reconstruction.
claim.scope: A possible documentary limitation, without identifying which additional records are missing.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies missing records as a possible limitation on record paths.

signal_basis.value: Trace approval-to-order record paths, test whether approval records can be found and linked, and document unsuccessful searches with their scope and access limitations.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed documentary observations for the flagged orders, assumed to occur for this assessment; no particular missing record is established.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the tracing operation, record-availability observations, search limitations and explicit qualification that observations are proposed.
The supported possibility claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Reconstruction depends on available documentary links. Missing records can remove such links and therefore affect the paths available for reconstruction. This licenses the stated possibility without establishing any particular loss.
uncertainty: Which records, if any, are missing and how their absence affects individual reconstructions remain unresolved.
